(:txn :owns ("asl/packages/asl-text/src/base64.asl" "asl/packages/asl-text/tests/base64Test.asl")
  (:step :op "write" :file "asl/packages/asl-text/src/base64.asl" :content :raw)
```
(module asl-text/base64
  :x [encode encodeNoPad encodeUrlSafe encodeUrlSafePad decode decodeUrlSafe]
  :i [])

fn stdAlpha -> Str
  "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"

fn urlAlpha -> Str
  "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789-_"

fn b64Char alpha: Str v: Int64 -> Str
  (optionOr (stringSlice alpha v (+ v 1)) "")

fn addPadding s: Str -> Str
  (let [(r (mod (stringLength s) 4))]
    (if (= r 2)
      (str s "==")
      (if (= r 3) (str s "=") s)))

fn encLoop bytes: Bytes alpha: Str i: Int64 n: Int64 acc: Str -> Str
  (if (>= i n)
    acc
    (let [(rem (- n i))
          (b0 (bytesGet bytes i))
          (b1 (if (< (+ i 1) n) (bytesGet bytes (+ i 1)) 0))
          (b2 (if (< (+ i 2) n) (bytesGet bytes (+ i 2)) 0))
          (v0 (/ b0 4))
          (v1 (+ (* (mod b0 4) 16) (/ b1 16)))
          (v2 (+ (* (mod b1 16) 4) (/ b2 64)))
          (v3 (mod b2 64))]
      (encLoop bytes alpha (+ i 3) n
        (str acc
          (b64Char alpha v0)
          (b64Char alpha v1)
          (if (> rem 1) (b64Char alpha v2) "")
          (if (> rem 2) (b64Char alpha v3) ""))))))

fn encodeRaw bytes: Bytes alpha: Str -> Str
  (encLoop bytes alpha 0 (bytesLength bytes) "")

fn encode bytes: Bytes -> Str
  (addPadding (encodeRaw bytes (stdAlpha)))

fn encodeNoPad bytes: Bytes -> Str
  (encodeRaw bytes (stdAlpha))

fn encodeUrlSafe bytes: Bytes -> Str
  (encodeRaw bytes (urlAlpha))

fn encodeUrlSafePad bytes: Bytes -> Str
  (addPadding (encodeRaw bytes (urlAlpha)))

fn stripPadLen bytes: Bytes n: Int64 -> Int64
  (if (and (> n 0) (= (bytesGet bytes (- n 1)) 61))
    (stripPadLen bytes (- n 1))
    n)

fn validPadding rawLen: Int64 n: Int64 -> Bool
  (let [(pad (- rawLen n))]
    (if (= pad 0)
      true
      (and (= (mod rawLen 4) 0)
        (or (and (= pad 1) (= (mod n 4) 3))
            (and (= pad 2) (= (mod n 4) 2))))))

fn decOutLen n: Int64 -> Int64
  (let [(full (* 3 (/ n 4)))
        (r (mod n 4))]
    (if (= r 2)
      (+ full 1)
      (if (= r 3) (+ full 2) full)))

fn charVal alphaBytes: Bytes c: Int64 i: Int64 -> Int64
  (if (>= i 64)
    -1
    (if (= (bytesGet alphaBytes i) c)
      i
      (charVal alphaBytes c (+ i 1)))))

fn decLoop src: Bytes alphaBytes: Bytes i: Int64 n: Int64 out: Bytes -> (Result Bytes String)
  (if (>= i n)
    (ok out)
    (let [(rem (min 4 (- n i)))
          (v0 (charVal alphaBytes (bytesGet src i) 0))
          (v1 (if (> rem 1) (charVal alphaBytes (bytesGet src (+ i 1)) 0) 0))
          (v2 (if (> rem 2) (charVal alphaBytes (bytesGet src (+ i 2)) 0) 0))
          (v3 (if (> rem 3) (charVal alphaBytes (bytesGet src (+ i 3)) 0) 0))
          (o0 (* 3 (/ i 4)))]
      (if (or (< v0 0) (or (< v1 0) (or (< v2 0) (< v3 0))))
        (err "base64: invalid character")
        (if (or (and (= rem 2) (not (= (mod v1 16) 0)))
                (and (= rem 3) (not (= (mod v2 4) 0))))
          (err "base64: non-zero trailing bits")
          (do
            (bytesSet out o0 (+ (* v0 4) (/ v1 16)))
            (if (> rem 2)
              (bytesSet out (+ o0 1) (+ (* (mod v1 16) 16) (/ v2 4)))
              ())
            (if (> rem 3)
              (bytesSet out (+ o0 2) (+ (* (mod v2 4) 64) v3))
              ())
            (decLoop src alphaBytes (+ i 4) n out)))))))

fn decodeWith s: Str alpha: Str -> (Result Bytes String)
  (let [(src (stringToBytes s))
        (rawLen (bytesLength src))
        (n (stripPadLen src rawLen))]
    (if (not (validPadding rawLen n))
      (err "base64: invalid padding")
      (if (= (mod n 4) 1)
        (err "base64: invalid length")
        (decLoop src (stringToBytes alpha) 0 n (bytesAlloc (decOutLen n)))))))

fn decode s: Str -> (Result Bytes String)
  (decodeWith s (stdAlpha))

fn decodeUrlSafe s: Str -> (Result Bytes String)
  (decodeWith s (urlAlpha))
```
  (:step :op "write" :file "asl/packages/asl-text/tests/base64Test.asl" :content :raw))
```
(module asl-text/tests/base64Test
  :x [runTests]
  :i [(asl-text/base64 :a b64)])

fn checkVector plain: Str padded: Str unpadded: Str -> Bool
  (let [(input (stringToBytes plain))]
    (do
      (assert (= (b64/encode input) padded) (str "standard encoding of " plain))
      (assert (= (b64/encodeNoPad input) unpadded) (str "unpadded encoding of " plain))
      (assert (= (b64/decode padded) (ok input)) (str "decode padded " padded))
      (assert (= (b64/decode unpadded) (ok input)) (str "decode unpadded " unpadded))
      true)))

fn testRfc4648Vectors -> Bool
  (do
    (assert (checkVector "" "" "") "RFC vector: empty")
    (assert (checkVector "f" "Zg==" "Zg") "RFC vector: f")
    (assert (checkVector "fo" "Zm8=" "Zm8") "RFC vector: fo")
    (assert (checkVector "foo" "Zm9v" "Zm9v") "RFC vector: foo")
    (assert (checkVector "foob" "Zm9vYg==" "Zm9vYg") "RFC vector: foob")
    (assert (checkVector "fooba" "Zm9vYmE=" "Zm9vYmE") "RFC vector: fooba")
    (assert (checkVector "foobar" "Zm9vYmFy" "Zm9vYmFy") "RFC vector: foobar")
    true))

fn testUrlSafe -> Bool
  (let [(input (bytesAlloc 3))]
    (do
      (bytesSet input 0 251)
      (bytesSet input 1 255)
      (bytesSet input 2 191)
      (assert (= (b64/encode input) "+/+/") "standard alphabet uses plus and slash")
      (assert (= (b64/encodeUrlSafe input) "-_-_") "URL-safe encoding without padding")
      (assert (= (b64/encodeUrlSafePad input) "-_-_") "URL-safe full quantum needs no padding")
      (assert (= (b64/decodeUrlSafe "-_-_") (ok input)) "URL-safe decode")
      (assert (err? (b64/decode "-_-_")) "standard decode rejects URL-safe characters")
      (assert (err? (b64/decodeUrlSafe "+/+/")) "URL-safe decode rejects standard punctuation")
      true)))

fn testUrlSafePadding -> Bool
  (let [(input (stringToBytes "f"))]
    (do
      (assert (= (b64/encodeUrlSafe input) "Zg") "URL-safe unpadded f")
      (assert (= (b64/encodeUrlSafePad input) "Zg==") "URL-safe padded f")
      (assert (= (b64/decodeUrlSafe "Zg==") (ok input)) "URL-safe decoder accepts padding")
      (assert (= (b64/decodeUrlSafe "Zg") (ok input)) "URL-safe decoder accepts omitted padding")
      true)))

fn testMalformed -> Bool
  (do
    (assert (err? (b64/decode "A")) "one-character quantum is invalid")
    (assert (err? (b64/decode "Zm$v")) "invalid character is an err")
    (assert (err? (b64/decode "Zg==\n")) "trailing whitespace is rejected")
    (assert (err? (b64/decode "Zg=")) "padding must complete a four-character quantum")
    (assert (err? (b64/decode "Zg===")) "excess padding is rejected")
    (assert (err? (b64/decode "Z=g=")) "padding in the middle is rejected")
    (assert (err? (b64/decode "Zh==")) "non-zero trailing bits in a two-character tail are rejected")
    (assert (err? (b64/decode "Zm9=")) "non-zero trailing bits in a three-character tail are rejected")
    (assert (err? (b64/decodeUrlSafe "A")) "URL-safe decoder validates length")
    (assert (err? (b64/decodeUrlSafe "Zg=")) "URL-safe decoder validates padding")
    true))

fn runTests -> Bool
  (and (testRfc4648Vectors)
    (and (testUrlSafe)
      (and (testUrlSafePadding) (testMalformed))))
```
